mechanics.claim: Only the first wall broken by contact deals damage; subsequent wall breaks deal no damage but still apply a shorter slow.
mechanics.quote: After the first wall breaks, the rest will deal no damage and {{tip|slow}} for only 1 second.

mechanics.claim: If The Box hits multiple champions on cast, only one wall (chosen by a clockwise rule from the wall in front-right of Thresh's facing) deals damage and applies the extended slow.
mechanics.quote: If ''The Box'' hits multiple champions with different walls on cast, only one of the walls will deal damage and apply the extended slow duration.

mechanics.claim: The Box cannot be interrupted once cast, including by Thresh's death.
mechanics.quote: ''The Box'' cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or {{tip|resurrection}}.
